status: Bounded K03 trace complete; implementation remains open

findings.observations: Valid XML name starts U+200C and U+3001 receive FOJS0009; all surrogate pairs are accepted before XName, including U+F0000/U+10FFFF outside the XML name range.
findings.next: K03-C01: scalar-aware XML NameStartChar/NameChar validation, NCName excluding colon; preserve FOJS0009 and existing option semantics.

findings.area: Map builder and provider name storage
findings.observations: Original U+1D11E and valid supplementary boundary names pass the map validator, then XName construction throws. Child, attribute and URI-qualified paths reproduce the same boundary. Existing default-mode provider construction leaks encoded local names.
findings.next: After scalar validation and serialization preservation, integrate a reversible provider representation across element/attribute names, prefixes, namespaces, copies and map round trips without altering node content.

findings.observations: Public ConstructElement in Xml11Mode retains literal sentinel text in StringValue, but ToXmlString changes that literal into A through whole-output DecodeName. ASCII and supplementary named controls both reproduce it.
findings.next: K03-C02: restrict name decoding to name tokens during serialization; preserve literal text/attribute/comment/PI content, escaping and namespace identity. Do not blanket-annotate map trees as a shortcut.
